notes: Source PDF lists members under the same section headings as the 8th Assembly PDF: 'N.W.F.P-26', 'THE FEDERALLY ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREA (FATA-8)', 'FEDERAL CAPITAL-01', 'THE PUNJAB', 'SINDH PROVINCE-46', and 'BALUCHISTAN-11' (this Balochistan heading text WAS captured for the 9th Assembly PDF, unlike the 8th). Provinces for NA-1 to NA-207 are taken directly from these headings/constituency numbering.

Of the 207 constituency seats (NA-1 to NA-207), 15 are printed as 'Vacant' in the source (no member holding the seat at time of publication) and are OMITTED from the members list per instructions not to invent members: NA-2, NA-45, NA-168, NA-169, NA-174, NA-175, NA-184, NA-185, NA-186, NA-187, NA-188, NA-190, NA-191, NA-192, NA-194. The remaining 192 seats are filled and included.

Seat NA-134 (labelled just 'Rajanpur', no Roman/Arabic suffix or explicit 'NA-' prefix in the source) is inferred as NA-134 from the sequential S.No column, matching the equivalent seat in the 8th Assembly list.

Non-Muslim members: heading reads 'LIST OF NON-MUSLIM MEMBERS IN THE NATIONAL ASSEMBLY  TOTAL-10'. Of the 10 listed slots (Sr. 208-217), Sr. 208 is printed as 'Vacant' and is omitted; the remaining 9 are named, grouped by 'Community': Christian (3), Hindu/Scheduled Castes (4), Parsi/Sikh/Budhists and others (1), Ahmadi (1). As with the 8th Assembly, elected_via is recorded as 'general' since these were separately/directly elected on nationwide non-Muslim electorates, not list-allocated.

Women members: this PDF contains NO 'WOMEN MEMBERS' section or heading at all - the document ends after the non-Muslim members list. This is consistent with the historical fact (given in task context) that the constitutional provision for 20 reserved women's seats lapsed after the 8th Assembly (1988-1990) and was not renewed for the 9th Assembly (1990-1993). No women's reserved-seat members are included in this file; none should be inferred.

OCR artifacts: the raw extracted text contained many stray mid-word spaces (e.g. 'Moham m ad', 'Haj i', 'I qbal'); these have been collapsed to normal spelling ('Mohammad', 'Haji', 'Iqbal') per instructions, with no other spelling changes made.
